facts.function: parts of solenoid-operated valves controlling hydraulic fluid in a vehicle braking system

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8481 covers valves and parts thereof
Section XVII note 2(e): articles of heading 8481 are not 'parts' of vehicles, so heading 8708 is excluded

rejected_alternatives.reason: Section XVII note 2(e) excludes articles of heading 8481 from vehicle parts
applies only to parts of iron or steel; material unknown
no evidence parts are electrical solenoid components classified by Ch. 85 rather than valve parts

missing_facts: whether the parts are valve bodies or other parts
whether the solenoid coil itself is imported separately (Ch. 85)
classification.rationale: Parts of solenoid valves fall in 8481.90 by Section XVII note 2(e) and heading 8481 text. J89209 (in force) classifies whole solenoid valves in heading 8481 and supports the heading only, not the part suffix. The 10-digit suffix depends on material and part type, so the choice is an assumption.
